description:
On behalf of the NIH Small Business Program Office (SBPO), you are cordially invited to participate in our upcoming Vendor Outreach Session (VOS) designed to strengthen engagement between small businesses and the NIH acquisition community.

Event Details:

Date: Wednesday, April 29, 2026
Time: 10:00 AM – 12:30 PM

Location: 6700 Rockledge Drive

                  Rm 6700B

                  Bethesda, MD 20817

Parking: Paid parking is available on-site

This session will provide an opportunity for small businesses to:

  • Overview provided by senior acquisition leadership
  • Gain insight into the NIH centralization
  • Better understand NIH procurement priorities and processes

We encourage participation from small business representatives to foster meaningful dialogue and collaboration.

Additional details, including the agenda and logistics, will be shared in advance of the session.

Please confirm your attendance by registering via NIH Small Business VOS Registration.

If you have any questions, please contact the NIH SBPO team at NIHSmallBusiness@mail.nih.gov.

We look forward to your participation.
